decisions.rationale: Johnny with partner Cristina appears in both pairs, the 2027 entry adds the Zebri surname as the full form of the same couple, and both are Swiss-stated.
Johnny Agostino is a solo entry with a distinctive surname, and the only shared element with the Johnny & Cristina couple is the first name Johnny in Switzerland.
Johnny Agostino (solo, Bern, January 2027) and Johnny & Cristina Zebri (Bern, March 2027) share a city and first name, but the surnames differ and no partner or event links them.
The solo Jojo Kizomba entry shares the first name Jojo and a France flag with the Jojo & Jenny couple, but Jojo is a common first name and no partner is shown.
The jojolpk key's own Madrid 2026 entry is JOJO LPK & JENNY, so the partner Jenny and the first name Jojo match the Jojo & Jenny couple.
Jorge & Angela and Jorge y Monica / Jorge & Monica have different partners, and the only shared elements are the common first name Jorge and Spain.
Jorge AZ (DJ) and Jorge & Rocio (teacher) share a Vigo event and date, and one person can teach and DJ, but Jorge is a common first name and no name element links them.
Jose & Anja (Fribourg) and Jose & Coralie (Geneva) have different partners, and the shared first name and Switzerland do not settle it.
Val & Jossy appears at the Tallinn festival in 2026 and 2027, and the 2027 entry adds Danza to Val's name as the same couple.
Jovany with partner Celine appears in both pairs, and the b-side name adds the Kizatours brand that the 2027 Tours Kizatours event carries.
Radu & Judit and Radu & Judith share the partner Radu and Romania, and Judit and Judith are spelling variants of one name.
Jules & Yuna (Martinique, France) and Jules & Yuna TarraxoPop share the same two full names and the same partner, differing only in a style tag.
Methodz & Julia and Methodz & Juliaa share the distinctive partner name Methodz and the same stated country, and Julia/Juliaa is a spelling variant.
Justin (solo) and Justine (in Jeremy & Justine) are names one letter apart, and the couple's partner Jeremy appears in none of the Justin entries.
Justin and Justin Welcome share the first name, the stated country France, and the urban style (Paris URBANKIZ, Brussels Urban), with Welcome as the full form.
JUSTINHNO and Justinho share a near-identical spelling, Senegal as stated country, and the URBANKIZ and Kizomba styles at matching France and Luxembourg events.
Justinho & A2Man and the solo Justinho share the exact stage name, France as stated country, and URBANKIZ and Kizomba styles across matching events.
Kal appears at the Atlantik Corazon Festival in Nantes 2026, and Ludo LSKiz & Kal appears at the same festival series in Saint-Nazaire 2027, both in France.
Camille & Karen and Luis & Karen have different partners, and the shared first name Karen and Spain do not settle it.
Karl and Karl Bekene share the first name, France as stated country on most entries, and Kizomba styles, with Bekene as the full form.
Karl (teacher) and Karl Conklass (DJ) share only the first name and stated France, and the different surnames and roles do not settle it.
Solo KATALIN and Azmael & Katalin (Budapest) share the name and Austria, but the solo entry could belong to any of her partnered couples.
Azmael & Katalin and Mathias & Katalin have different partners, and the shared first name Katalin and Austria are not enough to merge or separate.
Azmael & Katalin and Matthias & Katalin have different partners, and the shared first name Katalin and Austria are not enough to merge or separate.
Solo KATALIN at Crystal Kizomba Congress Vienna 2026 and Mathias & Katalin at the same congress in 2027 share name and city, but the solo entry could belong to either partnered couple.
Solo KATALIN (Vienna, April 2026) and Matthias & Katalin (Wels, March 2026) share the name and Austria, but a solo entry with a different partner does not settle it.
Mathias & Katalin and Matthias & Katalin are the same couple under a spelling variant of the partner name, with Katalin and Austria in both.
Kevin (Danang, stated Philippines) and Kevin Sato (Cebu, Bachata) share the first name and one Philippines and Bachata link, which is too thin to merge a common name.
Kiki (solo, stated Germany) and Fuego & Kiki (stated France and Germany) share the first name and country, but the couple's partner is absent from the solo entries.
Kiki solo at Kizbomba Evolution Vienna 2026 and Heneco & Kiki at Kizbomba Awakening Vienna 2027 share a festival series and city, but the partner names differ.
Fuego & Kiki and Heneco & Kiki have different partners, and the shared first name Kiki and the stated France and Germany do not settle it.
Fuego & Kiki and Selim & Kiki have different partners, and the shared first name Kiki and the stated France and Germany do not settle it.
Heneco & Kiki and Selim & Kiki have different partners, and the shared first name Kiki and the stated France and Germany do not settle it.
Klaudia & Jailson and Klaudia & Mateusz have different partners, and the shared first name Klaudia and Poland do not settle it.
Klaudio Hosai and Kludio Hoshai are spelling variants of one distinctive surname, and both entries state Angola.
Konstantinos & Anna (Salsa) and Konstantinos & Katerina (Bachata) appear at the same Sensualonica session on the same day with different partners, which points to two couples.
Konstantinos & Anna (Salsa) and Konstantinos & Zoe (Bachata) appear at the same Sensualonica session on the same day with different partners.
Konstantinos & Katerina and Konstantinos & Zoe are both Bachata at the same Sensualonica session on the same day with different partners.
Ichigo & Kristel and Kristel Ju share the partner Ichigo, and the b-side entries pair Kristel Ju with Ichigo, so Ju is the surname form.
DJ Lamin and DJ Lamin Lami both play the Crystal Kizomba Congress in Vienna with the Czech Republic stated, and Lami is a suffix on one stage name.
DJ Latin Master (Rotterdam, Salsa) and DJ Latin Pro Master (Groningen) differ by an inserted word, and two Dutch DJs with similar names do not settle it.
Damir & Laura and Mou & Laura have different partners, and the shared first name Laura and France do not settle it.
Davide & Laura and Dr Kizomba & Laura both appear at KIZMI Milano on 2026-12-17 (batch pair 346), so they are two different Laura couples with different partners.
Laura Buffone is paired with Dr Kizomba in Florence, and Dr Kizomba & Laura teach at KIZMI Milano on the same day as Davide & Laura, so Davide's Laura is not the Laura Buffone entry.
Doctor Kizomba & Laura (Bern 2027) and Dr Kizomba & Laura Buffone (Florence 2027) share the same partner name, with Laura Buffone as the full form.
DR. KIZOMBA & LAURA shares the partner name Dr Kizomba with Dr Kizomba & Laura Buffone (Florence 2027), a spelling-variant match on the same couple.
Laure and Laurie are names one letter apart, and their partners Dimitri and Thierry are different.
Franck & Laure and Franck & Laure de Rouen share the partner Franck and the first name Laure, with Rouen as the full form, and both use the SBK event brand.
Armand & Lavinia and the solo LAVINIA (Malaga) share the first name and stated Romania, but the solo entry has no partner name to link it.
Ledou Kingsman & Amina and Ledoux Kingsman share the distinctive surname Kingsman with a spelling variant of the first name, and France is stated on both sides.
